projects.name: winCMPSCentroid (third-party copy of KDOT WinCPMS project list, published by a KDOT consultant)
projects.notes: NOT the official endpoint: a point (centroid) copy of KDOT's WinCPMS project extents hosted by a consultant's ArcGIS Online account (item modified 2026-07-01), no cost field. Planned = proj_status_cd 'PLAN' or d_proj_let_date in the future (179 records with let date after 2026-11-16); ifrt_fiscal_programmed_yr gives the programmed year. The official KDOT layer is https://kanplan.ksdot.gov/arcgis_web_adaptor/rest/services/Transportation/WinCPMS/MapServer/0 (polyline, listed on ArcGIS Online by KDOT) but kanplan.ksdot.gov did not resolve from the research machine, so it is UNVERIFIED.
